joshua.1.p1.b1.text: Now after the death of His servant Moses,

joshua.1.p1.b2.text: the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,

joshua.1.p1.b3.text: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.

joshua.1.p2.b4.text: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.

joshua.1.p2.b5.text: … As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

joshua.1.p3.b6.text: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left …

joshua.1.p3.b7.text: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night …

joshua.1.p3.b8.text: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

joshua.1.p4.b9.text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people:

joshua.1.p4.b10.text: Prepare your provisions, for within three days you will cross the Jordan …

joshua.1.p5.b11.text: Your wives, your young children, and your livestock may remain in the land that Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But all your mighty men of valor must be armed for battle to cross over ahead of your brothers and help them,

joshua.1.p5.b12.text: Everything you have commanded us we will do, and everywhere you send us we will go.

joshua.1.p5.b13.text: … And may the LORD your God be with you, as He was with Moses. … Above all, be strong and courageous!
